snippet.title: Content Warning – Indie World Showcase 8.7.2025
snippet.description:
Content Warning is coming to Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 in 2026!

Get famous or die trying! In Content Warning, you’ll film scary stuff with friends to try and go viral. Grab a friend and play this co-op horror game in 2026.

#ContentWarning #NintendoSwitch2 #IndieWorld

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
